about: Declarations that cell 1 records rely on. Written by Tyche Institute for the IETF 127 Hackathon. Test use.

held_value.format: JSON text (RFC 8259), read with the I-JSON rules (RFC 7493) that RFC 8785 relies on
held_value.json_to_cbor: object -> map with text-string keys; string -> text string; integer -> major type 0 (n >= 0) or 1 (n < 0); array -> array; true, false, null -> simple values 21, 20, 22. The cell 1 payload has objects, strings and integers in the range -(2^53-1) to 2^53-1, and no floating-point numbers.

cpb.hash_envelope_preimage: jcs over the complete payload; no exclusion set; payload-hash-alg 258 = -16 (SHA-256); preimage-content-type 259 = application/json
cpb.cpb_refs_label_status: test-only private-use label; not an IANA assignment

contexts.representation_grammar: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, CBOR text string

cde.label_status: the value CDE -00 suggests for TBD_1; not assigned; test-only
cde.note: JCS is not a value of this parameter, and cell 1 does not invent one.

signing.alg_name: EdDSA with an Ed25519 test key, as in the CPB repository fixtures
